breakfast_bowls.name: Fruit and Nut Bowl
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into bowl
Layer blueberries, raspberries, papaya, and melon on top
Add pumpkin seeds, almonds, and coconut
breakfast_bowls.swapTip: Fruit, nuts, and seeds can be swapped for whatever you have on hand

breakfast_bowls.name: Five-Minute Breakfast Bowl
instructions: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine all ingredients
Mix well
Heat on high for 2 minutes until fully warmed
Stir and eat
breakfast_bowls.travelTip: Prep the night before and store in refrigerator

breakfast_bowls.name: Fresh Fruit and Granola Parfait Bowl
instructions: Line 2 bowls, each with 1/4 cup granola
Add Greek yogurt
Top with apricots, strawberries, blueberries, and remaining granola

breakfast_bowls.name: Apple Pie Breakfast Bowl
instructions: In a large bowl, combine almond milk, yogurt, maple syrup, vanilla, and salt
Mix in chia seeds and let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally
Cover and refrigerate overnight
Divide chia seed pudding between 2 bowls
Top with apples, granola, cranberries, and cinnamon
breakfast_bowls.swapTip: Add 2 tsp cacao powder for chocolate flavor

breakfast_bowls.name: Blueberry Chia Jam and Oatmeal Breakfast Bowl
instructions: For jam: In food processor, combine blueberries, maple syrup, vanilla, lemon juice, salt. Process until smooth.
With processor running, slowly add chia seeds until incorporated (5-10 seconds)
Scrape jam into jar, refrigerate until gelled (15-20 min)
For oatmeal: In large skillet over medium heat, heat coconut oil
Add oats, toast 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally
In large pot over medium heat, bring almond milk, water, salt, cinnamon to boil
Stir oats into liquid, cover, turn off heat, let sit 7 minutes
Divide oatmeal between 2 bowls, swirl in jam, top with almonds, coconut, chia seeds, flaxseed
breakfast_bowls.swapTip: This jam technique works for any berry

grain_bowls.name: Greens and Grains Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup red quinoa, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large pot over high heat, bring quinoa and water to a boil
Reduce heat to low, simmer 15-20 minutes until liquid absorbed
While quinoa cooks, combine kale, broccoli, Brussels sprouts, carrots, parsley, almonds, sunflower seeds in food processor
Pulse until roughly chopped
In small bowl, whisk olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, maple syrup, salt, pepper
Fluff quinoa with fork, divide between 2 bowls
Top with salad mixture, drizzle with dressing
grain_bowls.swapTip: Cook quinoa in vegetable stock for more flavor

grain_bowls.name: Roasted Beet and Quinoa Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup red quinoa, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F
On baking sheet, place beets with coconut oil, salt, pepper
Roast 30-35 minutes until fork-tender, cool 5 minutes
Meanwhile, cook quinoa: bring quinoa and water to boil, reduce heat, simmer 15-20 minutes
In large bowl, combine beets, quinoa, kale
Divide between 2 bowls
Whisk olive oil, orange juice, garlic, honey, tamari, balsamic vinegar
Pour dressing over mixture and serve
grain_bowls.swapTip: Butternut squash or sweet potato are delicious alternatives

grain_bowls.name: Winter Veggie and Grain Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F
In zip-top bag, place beets, sweet potato, cauliflower with olive oil. Massage to coat
On parchment-lined baking sheet, place veggies in single layer, season with salt and pepper
Roast 30 minutes, stirring halfway
While roasting, cook quinoa: bring quinoa and water to boil, reduce heat, simmer 15-20 minutes
In medium pot, boil water, add edamame, cook 5 minutes until tender, drain
In hot skillet, toast walnuts 4-5 minutes, stirring regularly
Divide quinoa among 4 bowls, top with roasted veggies, edamame, walnuts, cilantro
Top with Tahini-Ginger Dressing
grain_bowls.swapTip: Swap dressing for plain Greek yogurt

grain_bowls.name: Chili and Farro Bowl
ingredients: 1 (15-oz) can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15-oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: In slow cooker, place all ingredients
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
Divide chili and farro mixture among 4 bowls
grain_bowls.cookingTip: Double recipe and freeze extra batch

grain_bowls.name: Forbidden Rice Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups black rice, rinsed and soaked
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F
Prepare rice according to package instructions
In large bowl, combine rice, zucchini, peas, almonds
Toss with Jalapeño-Lime Vinaigrette
Divide between 2 bowls, top with orange zest, garnish with edible flowers

salad_bowls.name: Farm-Fresh Salad Bowl
instructions: Combine kale, cucumber, tomato, basil, olive oil, vinegar in large bowl
Toss well to combine
Divide between 2 bowls
Top with goat cheese and pecans
salad_bowls.swapTip: Swap kale for baby spinach or romaine

salad_bowls.name: Greek Salad Bowl
ingredients: 1/4 cup Kalamata olives, pitted and sliced
2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: In large bowl, combine lettuce, cucumber, red onion, tomatoes, peppers, olives
Sprinkle with oregano, season with salt and pepper
Drizzle with olive oil, toss gently
Divide between 2 bowls

salad_bowls.name: Ultimate Taco Salad Bowl
instructions: In cast-iron pan over medium-high heat, heat olive oil
Add ground beef, cook 7-10 minutes, breaking into crumbles, until browned
In small bowl, combine paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, oregano, cayenne
Add spice mixture and water to ground beef, stir to combine
Reduce heat to low, simmer 3-4 minutes
Divide lettuce between 2 bowls
Top with ground beef, avocado, tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, salsa
Drizzle with Jalapeño-Lime Vinaigrette, garnish with cilantro

soup_bowls.name: Rustic Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 (15-oz) can white beans, rinsed and drained
4 to 5 kale leaves, stemmed, roughly chopped
instructions: In large pot over medium heat, heat olive oil
Add onion, sauté 3-4 minutes until soft
Add carrots, celery, leek, cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently
Add garlic, cook 30 seconds
Add tomato paste, stir well
Add beans, diced tomatoes, broth, thyme, potatoes
Season with salt and pepper
Increase heat to high, bring to boil
Reduce heat, simmer 15-20 minutes until potatoes tender
Stir in kale, cook 5 minutes until wilted
Divide among 4 bowls

soup_bowls.name: Spiced Butternut Squash Soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F
Line baking sheet with foil, place squash cut-side down
Roast 60 minutes, cool slightly, scoop out flesh
Increase oven to 375°F, line baking sheet with parchment
In large pot over medium heat, heat 2 tbsp olive oil
Add onion, sauté 5-8 minutes until soft
Add squash, chicken stock, garlic powder, ginger, turmeric, white pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg
Season with salt and pepper, stir well
Bring to boil, simmer 20 minutes
In medium bowl, toss pumpkin seeds with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, cumin, garlic powder, paprika
Place on parchment-lined sheet in single layer
Roast 8 minutes, cool
Using immersion blender, blend soup until smooth
Divide into 4 bowls, top with toasted pumpkin seeds
soup_bowls.swapTip: Add pears or apples for extra flavor

noodle_bowls.name: Simple Noodle Bowl
instructions: In large skillet over medium-high heat, warm olive oil
Add garlic, carrot, zucchini, cook 7-8 minutes until tender
Add brown rice noodles, water, tamari, sesame oil, apple cider vinegar, honey
Stir to incorporate, cover skillet
Cook until water evaporates, stirring regularly, about 10 minutes
Add red pepper flakes, stir to combine
Divide among 4 bowls
noodle_bowls.swapTip: Omit noodles and spiralize 2 carrots and 2 zucchini instead

noodle_bowls.name: Garlic Shrimp and Zucchini Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 20 jumbo shrimp, tails removed, peeled, deveined
instructions: Place shrimp in large bowl, sprinkle with salt, pepper, garlic powder, toss to coat
In large skillet, heat 4 tbsp butter and garlic over medium heat
Add bell pepper noodles and onion noodles, sauté 4 minutes until soft
Add seasoned shrimp, cook 10-15 minutes until opaque
In medium skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 1 tbsp butter
Add zucchini noodles, cook 4 minutes
Divide zucchini noodles among 4 bowls
Top with shrimp and veggie noodle mixture

dessert_bowls.name: Chocolate Nice Cream Bowl
instructions: In blender, combine frozen bananas, cacao powder, maple syrup
Blend until thick and smooth, scraping down sides
Divide ice cream between 2 bowls
Top with coconut, chocolate chips, banana chips, strawberries
Serve immediately
dessert_bowls.swapTip: Swap cacao powder for any frozen fruit to customize flavor

dessert_bowls.name: Dark Chocolate Strawberry Bowl
instructions: In blender, combine avocado, cacao powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla, salt
Blend until thick and smooth
Divide avocado pudding between 2 bowls
Refrigerate 30 minutes
Top chilled bowls with strawberries and pistachios
Serve immediately
dessert_bowls.swapTip: Top with coconut flakes, chia seeds, or hemp seeds for crunch

bowl_necessities.name: Simple Lemon Dressing
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk lemon juice, mustard, shallot, garlic until combined
Slowly add olive oil while continuing to whisk until thickened
Season with salt and pepper
Store in airtight container in refrigerator 4-5 days

bowl_necessities.name: Jalapeño-Lime Vinaigrette
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, jalapeño, salt, pepper
Store in airtight container in refrigerator 4-5 days
bowl_necessities.swapTip: Swap lime juice for orange juice

bowl_necessities.name: Avocado-Cilantro Cream
instructions: In blender, combine yogurt, avocado, cilantro, lime juice, jalapeño
Season with salt
Blend until smooth
Store in airtight container in refrigerator 4-5 days
bowl_necessities.swapTip: Swap Greek yogurt with coconut yogurt for dairy-free
